stories.title: Stroomnet heeft te weinig ruimte voor álle geplande woningen, maar de bouwplannen van het kabinet kunnen doorgaan

en.title: Power grid has insufficient capacity for all planned housing, but government construction plans can proceed
en.summary: Network operators received about 600,000 requests for electricity connections by July 1, with capacity to fulfill half within three years. This is sufficient for the government's target of 100,000 new homes annually.

stories.title: De oppositie wil dat premier Jetten kíést – maar die heeft daar de politieke ruimte niet voor, blijkt na twee dagen Kamerdebat

en.title: Opposition wants Premier Jetten to choose – but he lacks the political room to do so, following two days of parliamentary debate
en.summary: Opposition parties pressed Premier Jetten during parliamentary debate to commit to either left or right-leaning coalition partners. Jetten declined to make this choice during the minority government's first General Debate.

stories.title: Ook na twee dagen debat vindt Jetten het te vroeg voor een keuze tussen links en rechts

en.title: Even after two days of debate, Jetten considers it too early to choose between left and right
en.summary: Premier Jetten declined to clarify his government's coalition strategy during parliamentary debate, stating the timing was premature. Opposition parties demanded he commit to a specific political direction.

stories.title: Geen begrotingssteun vanuit oppositie na Prinsjesdag: premier Jetten terug bij af

en.title: No budget support from opposition after Prinsjesdag: Premier Jetten back to square one
en.summary: Prinsjesdag marked the start of continued negotiations rather than securing budget support, leaving Premier Jetten without a parliamentary majority for government plans.

stories.title: Europa wil kinderen pas vanaf 13 jaar op sociale media, met veel controle door ouders

en.title: Europe wants children only on social media from age 13, with significant parental control
en.summary: The European Commission proposed legislation to restrict children's access to social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. Children would need parental consent from age 13, with full access only permitted at age 15.

stories.title: Voor bijna helft van geplande nieuwbouwhuizen is nog geen plek op stroomnet

en.title: Nearly half of planned new homes lack grid capacity
en.summary: Almost 50 percent of planned new residential construction over the next three years cannot be connected to the electrical grid due to capacity constraints, though sufficient connections exist to meet government building targets.

stories.title: Negende dode vrouw gevonden in Zuid-Afrika in dezelfde regio bij Johannesburg

en.title: Ninth murdered woman found in South Africa in same region near Johannesburg
en.summary: Police in South Africa discovered a ninth female victim east of Johannesburg, raising concerns about a potential serial killer. Eight other murdered women have been found in the same area since mid-July.

stories.title: Dit is het Europese masterplan om sociale media veilig te houden voor jongeren – gaat het werken?

en.title: This is Europe's master plan to keep social media safe for young people – will it work?
en.summary: The headline addresses European efforts to protect young people on social media platforms through regulatory measures.

stories.title: Opnieuw dode vrouw aangetroffen in Johannesburg, aantal slachtoffers nu negen

en.title: Another dead woman found in Johannesburg, victim count now nine
en.summary: South African police discovered another woman's body near Johannesburg on Thursday. Over the past two months, multiple murdered women have been found around the city, bringing the total number of victims to nine.

stories.title: Verdachte bekent aanranding en mishandeling van vijf vrouwen bij Delft

en.title: Suspect admits assault and abuse of five women near Delft
en.summary: A 19-year-old man arrested on suspicion of multiple assaults and abuse incidents near Delft has confessed. He is accused of pulling five women off their bicycles since July.

stories.title: Nederland daalt nog verder in emancipatieranking: ‘Het is beschamend dat ons land zo achterloopt’

en.title: Netherlands drops further in emancipation ranking: 'It is shameful that our country lags so far behind'
en.summary: The Netherlands has declined in an emancipation ranking, with commentators describing the country's performance as disappointing relative to other nations.

stories.title: Europese Commissie wil leeftijdsgrens van 13 jaar voor kinderen op sociale media handhaven met hulp van ouders en een identiteitswallet

en.title: European Commission wants to maintain 13-year age limit for children on social media with help from parents and an identity wallet
en.summary: The European Commission outlined details about a new Kids Act announced Wednesday, which aims to reduce child addiction to social media through age verification and parental involvement mechanisms.
